transcript: Just got out of memories of amorous gentleman, which just announced that it is closing early on this Sunday. And I will say, if you are on the fence like I was, I, I'm not necessarily going to recommend that you run and see this. I do think that as a show, it is virtually incomprehensible. The sightlines were bad. I it maybe the most uncomfortable I've been sitting in a theatre just because of the chairs at the back of the theatre space. But as somebody who's really been a fan of Duncan Sheik's music and knowing that these are kind of some of the last compositions that we're going to get from him, there was enough in the music itself that made it worth it to me to see it before it closed. There's a moment of a Sophia Anne Caruso wailing while sitting on a bench with an electric guitar playing underneath her that was exhilarating and to me, worth the price of admission, despite the fact that I do not think the show is good. So do with that information what you will. If you are on the fence and you are a fan of the scores of Alice by heart and American Psycho especially. There's a lot of American Psycho-esque songs in this, then, yeah, try to see this before it closes Sunday. Just go in with very low expectations for the story and bask in the vibes
